name: Watering can
prompt: Create a picture (generate an image, do not reply with text): a single cartoon a classic green metal watering can with a long spout, a rose sprinkler head, and an arched handle, side view, with a few water drops falling from the spout. Glossy cartoon mobile-game icon style: a thick, even dark brown outline; vibrant, saturated colors; smooth gel-like glossy surfaces with soft multi-tone gradient shading and soft clean highlights, with no sparkles, stars or glints anywhere; richly detailed but clean. Cute and friendly look. Drawn large with nothing cropped or hidden, as ONE single object only. Canvas: a square 1:1; the object fills most of the canvas. One plain solid white background, with no labels, no ground shadow and nothing else in the image. No text and no numbers.
